item.title: Senate passes the farm bill after a long night - National Wire
item.description: The Senate passed the farm bill early Thursday. Lawmakers from forty states backed it. A grower near Linden Falls said he would wait and see.

item.title: Linden Falls council votes on the bridge - The Linden Ledger
River bridge reopens after repairs - WXII
item.description: Crews in Linden Falls reopened the river bridge on Thursday. Traffic was light.
